concepts.description: A modular unit representing a component of the AUV system.
A platform within a module that represents the physical robotic system and uses defined interfaces.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system interact, specifying values and events.
A component within a module responsible for controlling or managing operations of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within a module to represent simple values such as numbers or strings.
A complex data type defined within a module that aggregates multiple named values of potentially different types.
A named data element within an interface that holds information of a specified type.
An occurrence or signal within an interface that can be triggered, optionally with parameters and a return value.
A defined operation within a module that takes input parameters and returns a value.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator components.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to manage operator-level commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller within AUV_Module representing the Last Response Engine, using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller within AUV_Module responsible for autonomous piloting, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing integer values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing string values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing boolean values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing real numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A composite type recording obstacle data including ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng fields.
A value of type real within the Sensors interface representing the depth measurement of the AUV.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface representing the heading of the AUV.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface representing detected obstacle data.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an obstacle collision maneuver.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a manual operation mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a hover control mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising heading.
A composite type recording close-distance data including horiz_cda and vert_cda of type real and id of type nat.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real value.
